svg.aria-label: Bytes held by a 16-flow shaper at 500 kbit/s per flow: megabytes on the router, where TCP gets no completion signal; 97 KB on the sender, where TCP small queues holds each flow to two skbs
svg.text: past the namespace boundary: no completion reaches TCP
16 HTB classes on rtr:r1, no deferred completion
TCP small queues: 2 skbs per flow, 32 in all
